citation: At the mixture separations of our empirical cases (2.0-6.2 within-component SD), pooled and 1,000-block jackknife SEs for the membership and component-location parameters agreed to within 1% (median ratio 1.000-1.001 genome-wide; simulated 95% coverage 0.925-0.985 under the null for both), the only departure being the upper-component location at low MAF with a large true effect at N = 10,000, which is independent of separation.
